description: Versioned Cloudflare Access configuration for the Lummet control plane (Round 6.3B). This is a reviewed template, NOT an applied Cloudflare payload: every value marked with an open-marker is an owner decision, and the application and policy stay unapplied until all of them are closed. Check it with scripts/cloudflare-access-config.mjs (offline, never calls Cloudflare). Live Cloudflare changes are owner-run; see docs/CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS.md.
status: [OPEN] owner has not approved this Access policy

application.name: Lummet platform control plane
application.hostname: [OPEN: control-plane hostname behind Cloudflare, for example the portal host]
application.audienceTag: [OPEN: the application's AUD tag, goes into CF_ACCESS_AUD]

identityProvider: [OPEN: approved identity provider and its connection id]

allowPolicies.name: Lummet staff
allowPolicies.include: [OPEN: approved staff group or email selector]

notes: Cloudflare Access is additional to Worker staff sessions, staff 2FA and RBAC; it replaces none of them.

neverProtect lists machine and public callers that cannot complete an Access login (Stripe webhook, CI release publishing with a staff token, uptime pinger, API keys, CSP reports, staff sign-in). The validator refuses any protected path that overlaps them.
The workers.dev hostname must not serve production traffic, because Access only protects the routes bound to the Access application (see the runbook).
